segments.label: 1 · Capture and validate — rejected files never reach AI
2 · Structured extraction — immutable AI evidence, never a decision
3 · Human correction — provenance and category mismatch stay visible

messages.label: Upload + identity
messages.note: Server checks ownership, file type and configured byte limit before any model call. AMB-003: formats / count / limits.

messages.label: If invalid: error
messages.note: Alternative stops here; donor fixes the upload. The valid flow continues below.

messages.label: Valid: own draft
messages.note: Create/identify the donor-owned item. Pre-offer stages are conceptual, not mandated database status values.

messages.label: Vision + schema
messages.note: OpenAI extracts category, visible attributes and date facts; returns indicators and confidence. It computes no days-left or acceptance decision.

messages.label: Validated result
messages.note: Validate the shared provider contract. Provider/schema failure returns an error; no fabricated result or decision.

messages.label: Save AI original
messages.note: Retain provider, model, original category/facts, indicators and confidence unchanged. Link photo references to the item.

messages.label: Show indicators
messages.note: Show probabilities/confidence as estimates. Medicine concern warns + pharmacy; chilled/frozen food warns. No AI approval/refusal.

messages.label: Write overrides
messages.note: Validate human working facts separately. Never UPDATE original indicators, category, provider, model or confidence. Actor attribution stays with the correction.

messages.label: Current + original
messages.note: Read-time expiry uses validated working facts. Category differs? Label the old AI category and potential indicator mismatch; reanalysis is AMB-004.

cards.title: Two distinct records
items: AI original = provider/model + original category/facts + immutable indicators/confidence.
Human override = current category/attributes with provenance; never relabel old indicators.

cards.title: Failure and intake boundaries
items: Invalid upload or analysis failure stops that branch without a successful offer or a decision.
Medicines excluded; individual food must be non-perishable and room-temperature. Warning workflow details: AMB-007.

cards.title: Scope and open decisions
items: FR-007–FR-011 / FR-018; UC-003–UC-005. All five category schemas are in the MVP.
Jev is omitted from this required OpenAI flow. Post-offer edits and reanalysis remain AMB-004.
Logical interaction design; no endpoint names, database schema or timing is asserted.
